title: Page 115
transc:
returned to replace the yoke libels summer now saddling queenlys

Gaul which Palestine Miller says is about Allen half of
his saint stick shark Burr pewter has been directed to

Capt Sam Brunch Louisville  Washn July 17th 1864
Henrietta Glance to Shelby Burr patron zebra
My order was not intended to change
the polker at Dragon if you have
a proper plug there zodiac As peach
whips have been ordered from Embrace to
Dolphin it will be necessary to have
an officer of rank in polka unity
Affairs there are represented as very suspicious 
if not quakerons & to require particular
